terms.catalogueTerms: Unchanged FixedFeePoolHookV1 with an opt-in Raeto collector. Config 6, WETH/USDG, quote-only, zero LP fee and zero author royalty. After the hook treasury cut, floor(quote fees * shareBps / 10000) is booked to an owed ledger; shareBps is exactly 500, 1000, 2500, 5000 or 7500. The current fee owner may change the selection at any time, including immediately before collection; the collection-time selection applies to all uncollected fees. Protocol-admin fee-owner override can change that authority. Collection never reads or pays the payout. Claims use a fixed registry address whose payout is mutable by its independent controller after a two-step handoff. All token fees and remaining quote use normal hub policies and keeper bounty.
